b23ea009226f2327.description: Why This Role Matters The Principal Specialist, Engineering and ETL (OT) enables Maaden to unlock the value of operational technology data by establishing scalable, secure, and reliable OT data engineering capabilities across the enterprise. The role ensures that operational data from industrial systems is transformed into trusted, accessible, and analytics-ready information that supports operational performance, decision-making, and digital transformation initiatives. The role strengthens enterprise data foundations by defining engineering standards, governance requirements, and integration patterns that enable consistent delivery of high-quality OT data products across multiple sites and operating environments. Through robust pipeline design and architectural leadership, the role improves data availability, reliability, and transparency while maintaining security and compliance requirements. By bridging operational technology environments with enterprise data platforms, the role accelerates analytics adoption, operational insight generation, and AI-driven innovation, enabling Maaden to build a sustainable and governed industrial data ecosystem. What You Will Deliver OT Data Engineering Strategy & Architecture Establish enterprise standards, frameworks, and reference architectures for OT data ingestion, transformation, and integration. Define scalable patterns that enable consistent access to operational data across sites, systems, and platforms. Strengthen alignment between OT data engineering practices, enterprise architecture, and governance objectives. Data Pipeline Reliability & Performance Deliver resilient OT data pipelines that ensure reliable, timely, and accurate operational data availability. Improve data consistency through robust handling of reconciliation, latency, backfill, quality validation, and exception management. Enhance platform performance through optimization, observability, and operational resilience initiatives. Data Governance & Security Embed governance, lineage, auditability, and quality controls throughout the OT data lifecycle. Strengthen compliance with OT security, segmentation, and enterprise data governance requirements. Ensure operational data remains secure, traceable, and aligned with enterprise risk management standards. Data Products & Platform Enablement Enable the creation of trusted OT data products that support analytics, reporting, operational monitoring, and AI use cases. Drive standardization of data models, tag structures, quality indicators, and transformation logic across industrial environments. Improve usability and accessibility of operational data for business and technical stakeholders. Technical Leadership & Assurance Provide architectural guidance for complex OT integration and engineering initiatives across multiple sites. Govern engineering quality by establishing technical standards, design reviews, and delivery assurance mechanisms. Strengthen delivery consistency across internal teams, partners, and vendors through expert technical oversight. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Advance OT data engineering capabilities through adoption of modern engineering practices and technologies. Improve efficiency, scalability, and cost effectiveness of OT workloads through continuous enhancement initiatives. Promote engineering excellence and knowledge sharing across the enterprise data ecosystem. What Success Looks Like OT data is consistently available, trusted, and accessible across enterprise analytics and operational platforms. Data pipelines operate with high levels of reliability, resilience, and performance across multiple sites. Governance, lineage, security, and auditability requirements are embedded within OT data engineering processes. Operational data products support business decision-making, performance management, and advanced analytics initiatives. OT-to-IT integration standards are adopted consistently across projects and operating environments. Engineering quality, delivery consistency, and platform scalability improve through defined standards and governance controls. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. Master s degree preferred. Exposure to Operational Technology (OT) systems is advantageous.

b2058887d84f419e.description: Job Title: Electrical Sales Engineer Department: Sales / Business Development Reports To: Sales Manager / Head of Sales Job Summary We are looking for an Electrical Sales Engineer who has knowledge in electrical systems sales and building good relations with our clients. Your main role is to find new sales opportunities, understand what customers need, and offer them the right electrical solutions. Key Responsibilities Find and approach new customers and maintain good relationships with existing ones. Archive and exceed Meet the sales targets set by the management. Promote and sell our electrical solutions including our services (e.g., equipment, testing devices, or power solutions). Prepare technical submittal, commercial and technical offers, follow the customers from A to Z. Follow up with customers from the initial inquiry until the final delivery. Coordinate with the technical team when needed to ensure the client gets the right solution. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering. Experience: 4 to 8 years of experience in technical sales or electrical engineering (KSA market experience in project specific). Technical Knowledge: Expert understanding of electrical solution especially in Medium Voltage fields (Switchgears, Transformers, Cables, RMU). Communication: Good communication and negotiation skills to deal with clients smoothly, have good and list of relationships with clients and access in mega projects. What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits): Attractive Basic Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary based on your experience. Strong Commission Scheme: High percentage commission on your sales revenue (Earn more when you sell more). Company Benefits: Medical Insurance, Paid Annual Leave, and Full Travel/Communication Allowances.

b21c26ee2c45c66a.description: Company Description Rezik Algedrawy Contracting Company (RGC) is a leading Saudi construction company with over three decades of experience delivering residential, commercial, infrastructure, and industrial projects across the Kingdom and the region. Job Summary: We are currently seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Planning Engineer (10+ years of experience) to join our team for prestigious projects in AlUla, Saudi Arabia . The candidate will be responsible for full schedule management, variation analysis, and delay claim substantiations. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update baseline schedules using Primavera P6 and MS Project. Manage Variation Orders (VOs), evaluating their technical, financial, and contractual impacts. Prepare, analyze, and substantiate Extension of Time ( EOT ) claims and identify Critical Path delays. Key Requirement: Prior experience working with BIF companies (preferably an approved/certified engineer by a BIF entity). b297f6c026134735.job_title: Executive Pastry Chef Four Seasons Resort at The Red Sea
b297f6c026134735.description: Executive Pastry Chef - Four Seasons Resort at The Red Sea, Saudi Arabia Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is seeking an Executive Pastry Chef for its upcoming resort at The Red Sea, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the pastry and bakery department, working in collaboration with the Executive Chef to manage all aspects of pastry and bakery operations. The position is based in the region between Umluj and Al Wajh. Role Overview The Executive Pastry Chef will be responsible for maintaining high standards of food quality and presentation within the pastry and bakery department. This includes leading a team of pastry professionals to deliver culinary experiences for guests, consistent with Four Seasons standards. The role requires attention to detail and a commitment to quality. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the pastry and bakery department, ensuring all products meet quality, consistency, and presentation standards. Oversee daily operations of the pastry and bakery kitchen, ensuring efficient service and resource utilization. Train, mentor, and develop pastry and bakery staff to enhance their skills and knowledge. Stay informed about current trends in pastry and culinary arts, integrating new techniques and ideas into menus. Collaborate with the Executive Chef to develop dessert menus aligned with the resort’s culinary vision. Manage inventory and ordering of pastry supplies to maintain adequate stock levels. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations. Foster a creative and inspiring work environment that promotes continuous improvement. Cultivate teamwork and collaboration within the pastry department. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in pastry and bakery operations. Demonstrated leadership skills in managing a culinary team. Ability to maintain high standards of food quality and presentation. Knowledge of current pastry and culinary trends. Strong organizational and inventory management skills. About Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts operates on a principle of valuing its team members, fostering an environment where individuals strive for improvement and treat each other with respect. The company aims to provide exceptional guest experiences through a commitment to luxury and genuine service, supported by a world-class employee experience and company culture. Four Seasons emphasizes recognition, welcome, and treating everyone with consideration, believing that meaningful connections enrich life experiences. About The Red Sea Destination The Red Sea destination, located along 200 km of coastline between Umluj and Al Wajh in Saudi Arabia, is being developed as a luxury beachside destination. The Four Seasons Resort will be situated on Shura Island, a central hub featuring a yacht marina, leisure facilities, retail, and an 18-hole golf course. The development prioritizes sustainable practices, utilizing renewable energy and extensive conservation zones. The new resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites with views of beaches and waters, six dining outlets, meeting spaces, a marine discovery center, and a full-service spa, among other amenities.

b2e2985f974a2885.job_title: Assistant Front Desk Manager Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island
b2e2985f974a2885.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
b2e2985f974a2885.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Assistant Front Desk Manager for its new Resort and Residences on Shura Island, Red Sea. This full-time position is located between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia. The Assistant Front Desk Manager will support the Front Office Manager in overseeing daily operations and ensuring high service standards for guest experiences. The Red Sea Destination The Red Sea destination, located along 200 km of coastline, is being developed with sustainable practices and tourism at its core. The new Four Seasons Resort on Shura Island will feature approximately 149 rooms and suites, six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery center, and various recreational facilities including a spa, tennis courts, and multiple pools. The resort aims to provide a comprehensive travel and lifestyle experience while minimizing environmental impact. Key Responsibilities Supervise the Front Desk team to ensure efficient guest check-in and check-out processes. Support the Front Office Manager in daily operations, scheduling, team development, and maintaining service standards. Address guest concerns and requests promptly and effectively. Ensure accurate recording and communication of guest preferences and special requests across departments. Oversee training and mentoring of Guest Services Agents and support team members. Assist in developing front desk procedures and systems in preparation for the resort opening. Collaborate with Housekeeping, Concierge, Guest Experience, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest journey. Manage VIP arrivals and special occasions with personalized attention. Monitor guest satisfaction scores and contribute to continuous improvement strategies. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisory or leadership role at the Front Desk in a luxury hotel or resort environment. Experience in a 5-star hotel or resort Front Office department. Pre-opening experience is considered an advantage. Required Skills A guest-focused approach with strong leadership and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Strong working knowledge of hotel property management systems. A proactive and adaptable attitude, with the ability to remain calm under pressure. Attention to detail and adherence to guest service standards. Work Environment The successful candidate will join a team committed to delivering service excellence within the Four Seasons brand. This role is based at the new Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island, a developing luxury destination in Saudi Arabia.

b25a087133584772.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء التحاليل والاختبارات المخبرية والكيميائية على العينات المختلفة، مع الالتزام بالمعايير والإجراءات المعتمدة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يقوم الكيميائي بتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام المخبرية الأساسية لضمان دقة وسلامة العمليات، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال وتحضير وتجهيز العينات لإجراء التحاليل المخبرية. إجراء التحاليل والاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها ودقتها. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد الكيميائية اللازمة للتحليل. مراجعة نتائج التحاليل والتأكد من دقتها ومطابقتها لمتطلبات الجودة. تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج الفحوصات في الأنظمة والسجلات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط الجودة ومراقبة جودة نتائج التحاليل. المحافظة على العينات والأجهزة والمواد المخبرية وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. الإبلاغ عن أي نتائج غير مطابقة أو أعطال فنية للمسؤول المختص. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب بيئة المختبر. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتحاليل والنتائج حسب متطلبات العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخلفية التعليمية والخبرة المناسبة للقيام بالمهام المخبرية بدقة واحترافية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الكيمياء أو التحاليل المخبرية. القدرة على إجراء التحاليل والاختبارات الكيميائية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة يجب أن يتمتع المرشح بالمهارات التالية لضمان الأداء الفعال في بيئة المختبر: الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع مراحل العمل المخبري. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في توثيق وتسجيل البيانات والنتائج. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. بيئة العمل تتطلب الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، والمحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم لهذا الدور في شركة اجال للمختبرات.

b201df910241ed08.description: About the Role Virtucruit is partnering with a leading mining company in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Assistant Driller within the Drilling Department. This full-time position is based in the Al Joshwan mountain range at 1,750m above sea level, in Najran. The role is suited for individuals who are prepared for remote work environments and are committed to achieving high performance and delivering quality test results. Key Responsibilities Ensure the highest level of safety, health, and environmental work standards are maintained. Assist with drilling activities, including mixing drilling fluids, assembling drilling tools, connecting sections of drill pipe, and operating machinery. Support the driller in equipment operation, such as raising and lowering the drill string and bit, maintaining rotation speed, weight on the bit, and mud circulation rate. Collect samples, ensuring bags/cores are correctly labeled, legible, kept in numeric order according to designated footages, and securely closed. Adhere to all health and safety regulations and procedures. Perform inspections and simple repairs on Surface and Underground exploration drill rigs (Epiroc Boyles and Diamec). Coordinate more complex repairs with the Lead Driller and M&R team. Maintain records of drilling conditions, measurements, and progress. Support the lead driller in logistics and maintenance activities. Assist in rigging up/down and moving to new drill locations. Fuel site equipment and assist in preventative maintenance (Oil Changes, Greasing, Fueling, etc.). Complete daily site inspections, mast inspections, and pre-shift inspections on all equipment. Maximize core recovery and monitor hole direction targets. Troubleshoot complex downhole problems. Identify basic mechanical issues on the drill rig. Maintain a safe work site and equipment. Comply with Health & Safety requirements and regulations. Perform other duties as assigned by the Lead Driller/Drilling Supervisor. Support the development and training of local nationals through mentorship, guidance, and coaching. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Standard First Aid Certification is required (Basic Safety Orientation is an asset). Technical Diploma or High School education with equivalent years of experience. Willingness to travel as required. Ability to work outdoors and/or in a shop environment. Holding a transferable Iqama and being available in the Kingdom is an advantage. Must be able to drive a light 4x4 vehicle and hold a valid Driver's License. Local to KSA or willing to relocate (a roster is offered for expatriates). Willingness to work in shifts and flexible time schedules. Ability to work in remote locations and in all weather conditions. Compensation and Benefits We offer a competitive employment package that includes a tax-free salary, short-term performance incentives, accommodation, transport, and food at the mine site, full medical coverage, and end-of-service benefits.

b205a69d69acf5d2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مرعي راشد الشاردي للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني ري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب أنظمة الري ومعايرتها وصيانتها، بالإضافة إلى المساعدة في تصميم أنظمة جديدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اختيار وتركيب أنظمة الري ومكوناتها بناءً على المتطلبات الزراعية والظروف البيئية مثل الرطوبة والارتفاع. معايرة أنظمة الري لضمان الاستهلاك الأمثل للمياه، ومراقبة الأداء، وتقديم المشورة للمزارعين حول الاستخدام السليم. صيانة وإصلاح أنظمة الري، بما في ذلك أداء الصيانة الوقائية واستكشاف المكونات المعيبة وإصلاحها. المساعدة في تصميم أنظمة ري جديدة أو محسنة، وتطبيق أحدث المنهجيات على الأنظمة الحالية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة الحصول على شهادة دبلوم فني ميكانيكي. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة أنظمة الري. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات المعمارية، مع التركيز على مشاريع الري. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

b21245168e005968.description: About Aroma City Group Aroma City Group is seeking a Senior Technical Director to join its team. This is a contract position based in Riyadh or Jeddah, offering a salary of up to 50,000 SAR. The role requires over 10 years of experience in technical leadership and design delivery. Role Overview The Senior Technical Director will lead the technical design and delivery of multidisciplinary Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems across various projects. This includes ensuring compliance with local and international standards, managing technical teams, and coordinating with various project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and technical delivery of multidisciplinary MEP systems, including HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, fire alarm, and electrical systems for residential, commercial, industrial, and healthcare projects. Direct design development, technical reviews, shop drawing preparation, coordination, and value engineering activities to ensure accuracy, constructability, quality, and timely project delivery. Ensure all MEP designs, specifications, equipment selections, and technical documentation comply with applicable local regulations and international standards, including ASHRAE, SMACNA, DIN, BS, EU, UPC, IPC, NFPA, and relevant energy codes. Review design drawings, technical specifications, equipment data sheets, material submittals, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and construction documentation prior to consultant or client submission and approval. Lead and supervise technical and design teams, delegate responsibilities, monitor productivity and project progress, establish priorities, and maintain high technical and performance standards. Coordinate closely with project management, operations, procurement, and cost control teams on BOQs, technical requirements, variation orders, approvals, and construction deliverables. Manage consultant and client technical approvals, conduct site inspections, resolve interdisciplinary coordination issues, and ensure approved documentation is efficiently transferred to project execution teams. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant technical leadership role. Demonstrated expertise in the design and delivery of multidisciplinary MEP systems. Strong understanding of local regulations and international standards for MEP systems. Proven ability to lead and manage technical and design teams effectively. Work Arrangement This is a contract-based position, with the flexibility to be based in either Riyadh or Jeddah. Compensation The salary for this role is competitive, offering up to 50,000 SAR, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

b269f4bf77a30a65.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الاتجاهات. مهارات قوية في التواصل وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتميز العمل ببيئة ديناميكية تتطلب متابعة مستمرة لتطورات السوق والمنافسين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية.

b27704e7ca94745b.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking an Associate ERM and Patient Safety Professional to join their team in Dhahran. This full-time role is responsible for managing the occurrence reporting process within the healthcare organization, ensuring all reported events are thoroughly reviewed, investigated, and actioned to enhance overall safety protocols. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to support and achieve risk management and patient safety standards. The professional will identify emerging risks and patient safety trends through event analysis, contributing to the continuous improvement of safety within the facility. Key Responsibilities Perform duties to support and achieve risk management and patient safety needs and standards. Ensure the facility complies with all government and local laws, as well as accreditation standards. Adhere to all hospital policies and procedures. Report potential new risk and safety themes and opportunities identified from event analysis. Document, monitor, and analyze patient safety events, developing action plans to prevent reoccurrence. Manage the event reporting process as designed within the hospital. Ensure all reported events are analyzed, reviewed, corrected, and actioned appropriately. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience, demonstrating a foundational understanding of risk management and patient safety principles within a healthcare setting. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Dhahran. The role operates within the structured environment of Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare. Application Information Join Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare in contributing to patient safety and risk management excellence.

b29435dfc517e31e.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking an experienced Planning Engineer – Mechanical to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This full-time role focuses on supporting project planning, scheduling, progress monitoring, and reporting for Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Refinery projects within Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in mechanical construction, maintenance, shutdown, and turnaround projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed project schedules for mechanical construction, maintenance, shutdown, and turnaround activities. Prepare baseline schedules, look-ahead schedules, recovery schedules, and progress updates. Monitor actual project progress against planned schedules, identifying delays, critical activities, and potential risks. Coordinate with Site Execution, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, QA/QC, and HSE teams to ensure timely project execution. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports and planning dashboards. Track manpower, equipment, materials, productivity, and resource requirements. Analyze project performance and provide recommendations for schedule recovery and corrective actions. Monitor critical path activities and ensure timely completion of project milestones. Prepare progress measurement and quantity tracking for mechanical activities. Support the preparation of S-curves, progress curves, histograms, and productivity reports. b2861c0506c8b577.description: ELEVATE MENA – JOB DESCRIPTION Regional Financial Controller Location: Riyadh, KSA Elevate is an award-winning global sports and entertainment agency founded in 2018 and the chosen growth partner for the world’s leading brands, properties, and experience-driven businesses. Key responsibilities: Financial control and reporting: · Own the monthly, quarterly and year end close across the MENA entities, ensuring accurate results, appropriate cut off and timely reporting to regional and Group stakeholders. · Prepare and review management accounts, balance sheet reconciliations, cash flow reports and supporting schedules, with clear commentary on material movements, risks and required actions. · Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, master data and intercompany balances, reviewing the work produced by the finance team · Ensure Group accounting policies and IFRS requirements are applied consistently across all MENA entities, providing guidance on complex or judgemental matters. · Lead the regional statutory audits and coordinate the timely completion of financial statements and other external reporting. · Planning and business support · Work with the Finance Business Partner to resolve accounting issues affecting project reporting, and review the treatment of revenue recognition, contract arrangements and margin. Commercial ownership stays with the business leader and Finance Business Partner. · Support assessing the accounting, tax and entity implications of new contracts, bids and cross border activity, working with external advisers where needed. Treasury and working capital · Maintain short and medium term cash flow forecasts across the region, and support the Regional Finance Director on funding and liquidity decisions. · Review accounts receivable, collections, billing and accounts payable, with a strong focus on reducing unbilled revenue and overdue receivables. · Oversee payments, bank reconciliations, bank mandates and treasury controls, including cross border and intercompany transactions. Compliance and controls · Ensure compliance with accounting, tax and regulatory requirements across MENA, managing statutory obligations and coordinating with local advisers so records are complete, submissions accurate and payments on time. · Maintain and improve controls over purchasing, supplier onboarding, expenses, payroll inputs, payments and balance sheet accounts. · Identify control gaps and close them in ways that protect the business while allowing commercial activity to move efficiently. Systems and data · Own the effective use and ongoing development of NetSuite across the MENA finance function. · Automate finance processes to reduce manual work, allowing the team to focus on review, analysis and decision support. · Establish clear documentation for key finance processes, controls and system procedures. · Team leadership and stakeholder management · Lead, coach and develop a team of three, setting clear responsibilities, priorities and performance expectations. · Ensure the team has the knowledge and cross cover to sustain all key finance activities. · Build a collaborative finance function that supports the business while maintaining appropriate challenge, accountability and control. · Develop effective relationships across regional leadership, business unit heads, project teams, Group Finance, HR, Operations, banks, auditors and advisers. Experience and qualifications · Qualified accountant with a minimum of ten years' relevant finance experience. · Significant financial controllership experience in a multi entity and multi currency environment in the Middle East, particularly across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. · Strong knowledge of IFRS, statutory and management reporting, audit, tax compliance, treasury and working capital management. · Experience in a project based services business is essential. Sports, entertainment, events, sponsorship, marketing, media or agency experience would be highly desirable. · Practical experience using automation or AI tools to improve finance processes and analysis would be beneficial. · Arabic language skills would be advantageous but are not essential. Capabilities and behaviours · Hands on and comfortable moving between detailed accounting matters and wider regional business priorities. · Commercially aware, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and recommend practical solutions. · Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast moving environment. · A clear communicator who can translate financial issues into straightforward actions for non finance colleagues. · High integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership. · Resilient, collaborative and comfortable working across different cultures, entities and locations.
